The yellow-topped bread could contain cheese as sandwich filling or simply be buttered toast, leaving sandwich unclear. The browned sausage links do not resolve frankfurter versus other breakfast sausage, so hot dog remains unclear. I considered all 75 definitions; no other defined object is supported.

No tines or spoon bowl are identifiable. I considered each of the 75 definitions; no other listed food, vessel, furnishing, animal or other object is established.
